articles.author: Chris Branch
articles.description: Many products at Cloudflare aren’t possible without pushing the limits of network hardware and software to deliver improved performance, increased efficiency, or novel capabilities such as soft-unicast, our method for sharing IP subnets across data centers. But sometimes we try to push well beyond the design intentions of Linux’s networking stack. This is a story about one of those attempts.
